releaseNotes.zh: 助手对话更简洁，暂停时可编辑下一条消息；改进菜谱、菜单和食材数量处理。主动反馈时附带请求编号，方便定位失败原因。支持本地做饭提醒。Android AI 沿用现有邀请码；覆盖安装保留本地数据。
releaseNotes.en: A compact assistant chat with editable drafts while paused, improved recipe/menu decisions and quantity handling, request references in voluntary feedback, and local cooking reminders. Android AI retains existing invitation access; install over the existing app to keep local data.
